findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "ai" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: llm_messages · Private data: json_repair, work_grade, qr_generate, image_generate, image_analyze, image_ocr, audio_transcribe, text_to_speech, prompt_guard, pii_redact, content_safety · Public sink: text_keywords.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: llm_messages · Private data: json_repair, work_grade, qr_generate, image_generate, image_analyze, image_ocr, audio_transcribe, text_to_speech, prompt_guard, pii_redact, content_safety · Public sink: text_keywords

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
